title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
abstract: arXiv:2610.35671v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). translated_abstract: 随着前沿语言模型能力日益增强且日趋自主，独立第三方评估对于刻画其系统性安全风险至关重要。虽然闭源模型发布时通常伴随全面的系统报告，但开放权重模型在前沿风险方面受到的审查却较少。为填补这一空白，我们对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017进行了独立安全评估，该模型是V4.1 Flash的最新版本，采用了全新架构、更大规模的训练以及强大的智能体能力，与V4有显著区别。参照欧盟《通用人工智能实践准则》，我们在34个基准测试（包括5个内部测试套件）上对该模型进行了评估，涵盖评估完整性、失控和有害操纵三大领域。遵循AEF-1标准，我们将V4.1 Flash-1017与V4.1 Flash、更早的DeepSeek V4模型以及领先的闭源系统（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol和Gemini 3.8 Flash）进行了比较。总体而言，V
tldr: 该论文依据欧盟通用AI实践准则，对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017开展了独立第三方安全评估，在34个基准上系统测试其失控与有害操纵风险，并与多个领先的闭源前沿模型进行了对比。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 across 34 benchmarks under the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, assessing loss-of-control and harmful manipulation risks and comparing it with leading closed-source frontier models.
